references.text: Describes the anointing and consecration of priests, where Aaron's holy garments were to pass down to his sons after him
Concerns the anointing of Aaron and his sons to consecrate them for priestly service
Mentions the anointed priest (הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ) who performs atonement
Speaks of the priest who is anointed in place of his father, to present the offering
Describes the anointing of Aaron for priestly service
Describes the linen garments (בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד) as the holy clothes the priest must put on
Refers to the high priest who is anointed and consecrated to wear the holy garments
Tells of Eleazar taking over the priesthood after his father Aaron
Mentions the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil
Contrasts the law that appoints weak men as high priests with the oath that appoints the Son forever
Describes the high priest's annual entry into the Most Holy Place to make atonement
